edge_explainer.market_believes: A melting-ice-cube auto-parts spinoff: Continental kept the crown-jewel tires business and dumped this, order intake collapsed -32%, and DAX index funds were forced sellers — cheap for a reason.
edge_explainer.we_believe: The order collapse is concentrated in ONE segment and is mostly a prior-year base effect (a terminated EU program + a one-off mega-award); peers who bid the same contracts show NO industry air-pocket (Valeo's orders +38%). Net cash is ~€14/share of the ~€38 price, and the 46% family anchor plus CEO/CFO open-market buys de-risk the downside.
edge_explainer.why_we_might_have_edge: Corrected after a skeptic pass: the 'nobody does this work' claim was wrong — ten analysts cover it (consensus ABOVE our price), the forced index selling cleared six months ago, and the stock re-rated INTO the print, so the market is visibly running the same peer read-across. What we actually hold: a compensated risk premium — ~EUR14/share of net cash and a 46% committed family anchor against a genuinely contracting order book — plus one residual timing convenience: our peer watch updates the order-recovery odds as each peer prints before Aug-6. That's diligent housekeeping, not an information monopoly.
edge_explainer.why_it_might_be_priced_in: The stock already re-rated €35.9→€37.7 into the print — roughly half the recovery odds are now priced. The remaining unpriced piece is the margin/cash leg (~Nov), not the order line. Part of the lost order base is permanently gone.
edge_explainer.what_resolves_it: Aug-6 H1 print: does Q2 book-to-bill cross back above 1.0 (management says 'delayed, not cancelled' — unproven until then), and does the margin step toward 3.5%?
edge_explainer.edge_type: compensated risk premium (net-cash floor + anchor); the read-across is consensus work, kept for monitoring not edge
edge_explainer.mechanism_falsifier: Already partly falsified: the +5% pre-print re-rate showed the market pricing the read-across in real time. If Aug-6 confirms and the stock barely moves, the recovery was fully priced and the position is pure risk-premium carry.
